title: Scale the one sealed final evaluation to1000 or the full1319 questions
count_semantics: The1000 target means independent benchmark questions, not1000 training runs or software checks. Each evaluated checkpoint answers the same questions.
existing256_protocol_status: prepared_only_unexecuted; preserve it as history and do not perform a256-question peek before deciding the larger fixed target

recommendation.reason: Full1319 is the standard complete GSM8K benchmark and removes subset-selection ambiguity. It is31.9% more questions than1000; compute differences appear modest relative to engineering and checkpoint-loading overhead.
conditions: Finish training selection using development data only; freeze one chosen adapter and untouched original before any final access.
Measure base200 and chosen-development generation times first; choose shard size from the larger observed cost with a1.25 margin, then freeze all shards.
Freshly reconcile all current Modal and DeepSeek liabilities; fund the entire final bundle and a separate serving/recovery allowance within30/20 service ceilings.
Do not begin1000, inspect results and then expand to1319. Choose1000 or1319 once before opening the split.
If full does not fit the reconciled budget, choose the seeded1000 subset before access or defer execution. Never tune, resample easier questions or add checkpoints after test access.

budget_snapshot.freshness: Local snapshot only, not a provider refresh or future funding approval.
budget_snapshot.protected5_note: The existing protected5 is earmarked for final evaluation and capped serving, not extra training. It does not cover this proposed full worst-case bundle by itself. Finalization must explicitly allocate funds and retain a separate serving/recovery allowance; this design reallocates nothing.

evidence_and_assumptions.cost_model: Standard A10080GB function,4 physical CPU cores,32GiB, no region premium or non-preemptible multiplier. All paired GPU calls run sequentially; teacher collection may run separately with at most4 requests.
evidence_and_assumptions.teacher_input_bound_scope: A precommitted API request cap to validate only after the final seal and authorized access; it is not evidence of the observed official-test maximum. Every over-cap question retains a failed outcome in the full fixed denominator, with no filtering or resampling.
forecast_limitations: These are development-based extrapolations, not official-test observations or guarantees. Output length, padding, GPU contention, source length and final adapter behavior can change runtime.
The80-second per-call load allowance and1.25 multiplier are planning assumptions. Replace them using the future base200 and chosen-development observations before sealing.
Resource allowances exclude unbounded new image builds, exceptional storage/egress and provider price changes. Rounded reservations need fresh pricing/accounting and contingency review.
The current3-dollar-per-call guard remains in force. Lower protocol-specific reservations would require a separately reviewed executor version; this design does not weaken existing guards.

scenarios.teacher_wall_time_note: The120-second urllib timeout is not an end-to-end process deadline; this scheduling envelope is conditional, not a guaranteed wall-time bound.

teacher_budget_interpretation: At matched nonthinking512 and bounded2000 input tokens, full1319 has a conservative peak token bound of6.15645888USD; no cache or off-peak discounts are assumed.

Thinking4096 would cost up to18.86016USD for1000 or24.87655104USD for1319 before prior usage. At the current1.44USD prior estimate, neither belongs inside the20USD total ceiling. Do not silently substitute the older thinking4096 collector.

Every wrong, truncated, input-limit and API-failed outcome remains in the frozen denominator. Preserve response model alias, usage, exact raw receipt and latency provenance. Teacher answer agreement is not proof of correct reasoning.

Before dispatch, verify actual serialized-message byte bounds or a reviewed conservative token-bound method. A1900-byte rejection rule may create failures; it must be predeclared and never used to replace questions.

already_present: Permit-before-read and one durable dataset owner; pinned source/sample hashes for resume.
Chosen adapter inventory hashes verified before loading; original/chosen separated; one GPU and zero automatic retries.
Per-batch raw generation receipts with hashes, contiguous-prefix recovery and unique remote attempt ownership.
Teacher pretransmission intent and exact raw provider receipts; ambiguous attempts are not blindly retransmitted.
required_pre_access_changes: Version the final protocol and reviewed capability counts away from hardcoded256; choose full range(1319) or one seeded1000 subset before access.

Generalize final_eval_control chosen_checkpoint validation from exactly64 development outcomes to the approved chosen study64 or200, with exact source/protocol/result hashes and no test-based selection.
Create immutable shard manifests under the one dataset permit: global ordered IDs, checkpoint identity, shard offset/count, sample hash and disjoint union equal to the sealed1000/1319 set.
Update final_test_loader count checks and full_test_evaluation metadata consistently while preserving one source read and the same receipt on recovery.

Update final_eval_jobs and modal_final_eval bounds,requested counts,loops and result validation to the sealed shard count. Full1319 has a final7-question batch; divide amortized timing by actual batch length and preserve all7 outcomes. Do not pad the benchmark with duplicated questions.

Change validate_saved/validate_batch to accept the one legitimate final partial batch and verify expected global shard IDs/offsets; retain byte-exact batch hashes and same-protocol terminal-only recovery.
Keep per-checkpoint/shard unique claims and one active GPU; reconcile ambiguous spawns and confirm terminal before reusing only missing outputs under a new reserved recovery attempt.
Generalize final_teacher max_attempts and expected count to the sealed1000/1319 protocol; preserve all-outcomes scoring, immutable request manifests, at most4 workers and no retries.
Add a global collection deadline or reviewed chunk scheduling with fresh accounting between chunks; urllib timeout alone is not a whole-run wallclock bound.

Predeclare prompt-plus-generation context handling before access. The existing final worker checks prompt<=2048 rather than prompt+512<=2048; over-limit cases must become retained failures under a fixed rule, never replacement questions.

Introduce separately reviewed protocol-specific resource reservations only if needed; the existing fixed3USD guard cannot simply be bypassed. Fund the whole final exposure and recovery contingency before opening test data.

Add synthetic-only fixtures for1000/1319 coverage, nonoverlap,7-row tail, budget refusal, ambiguous launch, raw-prefix recovery, wrong/failed outcomes and aggregate-only reporting. No official test content is needed for these checks.

reporting_protocol.primary_comparison: Frozen chosen Granite versus untouched original on the identical sealed question set; DeepSeek is a separate teacher reference under the same user prompt and512 output cap.
required_outputs: Numeric accuracy count and denominator, strict-format accuracy, truncation/failure counts and coverage for every model.
Paired corrected/regressed counts, difference in percentage points, question bootstrap interval and exploratory exact McNemar comparison.
Accuracy and paired-delta plots with complete-only points; separate API round-trip and amortized GPU timing views.
Actual model-answer count, trained-example/token exposure and software-check count as distinct quantities.
Shard/attempt timing, raw receipt hashes and missing/ambiguous outcomes; no claim that a partial run is full1319.
limits: A single frozen adapter and one training seed do not establish robust seed-to-seed gains.
Full1319 gives an exact score on this benchmark, not certainty about all future math questions. Paired question uncertainty does not measure training-seed variability.
Illustrative3.10pp versus2.70pp worst-case independent-question intervals are not effect-size forecasts; actual paired precision depends on discordant outcomes.

Keeping official test unopened during project development does not establish absence of model pretraining or third-party-corpus contamination. Any later overlap diagnostic must be predeclared and must not alter the official primary denominator.
